We recently released EMM-1 - the world's largest open-source multimodal dataset, with 107 million image, video, text, audio and point cloud embeddings - and thought it might be relevant given the work you're doing.

Our engineering team has been building out dataset curation and label validation tooling specifically for AI teams at your stage of scale - we're working with teams like Veriff and would love to get your take on what we've shipped.

Would you be open to a quick 15-minute chat to take a look, see if there's any overlap, and share some honest feedback?

Best,
Andrew
